shortDescription: List and filter on Monitor Logs Streams.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Monitor Logs Streams to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Monitor Logs Streams.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Monitor Logs Streams in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Monitor Logs Streams by.
